Job Description: \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

**Please note:** We will only contact you through our email domain **@tier9studios.com** \- please report any emails you receive from any other domain.

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

**Role:** Visual \& Motion Artist – Mobile Game Marketing (Gacha RPG)

**Location:** Toronto, ON, M5C 1P1

**Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site

**About Us:** Tier 9 Game Studios is a fast\-paced mobile games company focused on creating industry\-changing mobile role\-playing games. Our live\-service game is Auto Battles Online but we're actively developing a new game called Auto Battles World, an ambitious Gacha Idle RPG with a 2D open world. We need someone who can make our game look incredible in a 15\-second video — and make people stop scrolling to watch it.

**Role Overview:** You'll create the short\-form video ads that drive our player growth. If you love editing video, have strong instincts for what makes a viewer stop and watch, and understand what makes gacha and idle RPGs satisfying to play, this role is built for you. You'll work with gameplay footage, character art, UI elements, and original concepts to produce a high volume of video ads for Meta, TikTok, Google, and other platforms.

**Responsibilities:**

* Edit and produce short\-form video ads (15–30 seconds) using gameplay capture, character sprites, UI elements, and motion graphics.
* Craft strong visual hooks in the first 2–3 seconds — the opening matters more than anything else.
* Create multiple variants of each concept: different hooks, pacing, text overlays, CTAs, aspect ratios, and end cards.
* Work with gameplay recordings and 2D art assets to make the game look exciting, satisfying, and worth downloading.
* Study competitor ads and trending video formats to stay sharp on what's working in mobile gaming right now.
* Produce at a high cadence — testing quickly and frequently is key!
* Create promotional assets for in\-game events, updates, and seasonal campaigns.
* Build and maintain an organized library of creative assets, hooks, and performance learnings.

**Qualifications:**

* Portfolio demonstrating short\-form video work you personally edited and produced. This is required — applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.
* Strong video editing skills in tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar.
* Motion graphics skills (After Effects, animations, etc.)
* Good eye for pacing, visual hierarchy, text placement, and mobile\-first composition (vertical, sound\-off, small screen).
* Ability to produce volume without sacrificing clarity — you're comfortable shipping multiple variations per week.
* Experience as a player of gacha, idle, or online role\-playing games (MapleStory, Idleon, AFK Arena, Idle Heroes, Summoners War, Raid: Shadow Legends, etc.)
* Experience with A.I. creative tools for scaling production (image generation, video generation, copy tools) is a strong asset.
* Willingness to learn from performance data. You don't need to be a data analyst, but when a video gets great click\-through rates, you should be curious about why — and ready to make more like it.
* Proactive and independently motivated.
* Positive attitude and genuine interest in mobile games!

**Benefits:**

* We don't require native fluency in English, only a level of proficiency sufficient for creative work and team discussions. We're willing to accommodate for this!
* Collaborative and creative work environment. We operate closely together and treat everyone with respect.
* Opportunity for career advancement and skill development. This role has a clear path toward Creative Director or Marketing Lead as we grow.
* Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and extended health benefits. This includes massage therapists, physiotherapists, counsellors and more!
* Regular team meals and outings plus an abundance of in\-office snacks, on the house!
* Direct impact on the game's growth — your creatives will be the primary way players find our game.

**Application Process:** To apply, please submit your resume, including a link to your portfolio or creative work samples.

Job Description: **Our Coffee May Give You Superpowers.** 

Coffee is our craft, and everything we build around it, the way it looks, feels, and moves people, is how we share that craft with the world. We believe great specialty coffee should be accessible to many, and the visual story we tell is a huge part of making that happen. We're looking for the person who brings that story to life visually, across every platform our brand touches.

**What You'll Be Doing** 

● Bringing De Mello's visual brand identity to life across social creative, product design, packaging concepts, and our websites

● Leading the visual expression of new product concepts, working closely with our Head of Brand \& Growth and leadership on creative direction

● Keeping our website's product pages sharp and consistent with the brand as it evolves

● Partnering closely with our Social Media \& Content Marketing Coordinator in creating various social media assets

● Contributing ideas freely. We build through collaboration, and the best work here comes from many voices

● One to two years of experience in graphic design, brand design, or a related field (or equivalent proof of your qualifications through your portfolio)

● A design sensibility that flexes between bold and whimsical for our consumers, and composed and credible for our industry partners

● A genuine excitement for specialty coffee, or a real willingness to grow into loving it

● Real fluency with AI design tools as part of your creative process

● A cultural innovator with a strong understanding of our target audience and social media trends

This role sits at the centre of our marketing team, but you'll work cross\-departmentally as needed, since we believe versatile, growth\-minded people are what carry a brand forward. Brand and marketing are core to how we carry our vision, and we're building this team because we believe in where that vision is headed. There's real opportunity here to grow into something bigger as the brand grows.

Full health benefits and of course, unlimited delicious coffee ☕

Job Description: The Ontario Tobacco Research Unit (OTRU) was established in 1993 as the research and evaluation component of the Ontario Tobacco Strategy with initial funding from the province and in\-kind contributions from the academic community. Over two and a half decades, we have become a key player in the tobacco control community in Canada and internationally. OTRU is located within the Institute of Mental Health Policy Research (IMHPR) at the Centre for Addiction and Mental Health (CAMH).


OTRU is seeking a full\-time, 12\-month contract, bilingual (English \& French) Research Analyst to support a range of research, evaluation, implementation, and quality improvement related activities. This role requires a well\-organized, highly energetic and motivated individual who will work closely with a team of community members, people with lived/living experience, research personnel, and Scientists to support the implementation of a research study (Smoke\-Free Connect). This study is funded by Health Canada to implement online and in person activities to provide community connectedness among people trying to quit smoking living in rural and remote areas.


L’Unité de recherche sur le tabac de l’Ontario (URTO) a vu le jour en 1993 à titre de volet recherche et évaluation de la Stratégie antitabac de l’Ontario, grâce à un financement initial de la province et aux contributions en nature de la communauté universitaire. En plus de deux décennies et demie, elle s’est imposée comme un acteur incontournable de la lutte antitabac au Canada et sur la scène internationale. L’URTO est hébergée au sein de l’Institut de recherche en politiques de santé mentale (IRPSM) du Centre de toxicomanie et de santé mentale (CAMH).


L’URTO est à la recherche d’un analyste de recherche bilingue (français et anglais), à temps plein pour un contrat de 12 mois, afin de soutenir un vaste éventail d’activités liées à la recherche, à l’évaluation, à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration de la qualité. Ce rôle exige une personne rigoureusement organisée, débordante d’énergie et animée d’une véritable motivation, qui travaillera en étroite collaboration avec une équipe composée de membres du public, de personnes ayant une expérience vécue ou vivante, de personnel de recherche et de scientifiques, afin de soutenir la mise en œuvre d’une étude de recherche (Communauté sans fumée). The candidate will be responsible for a range of activities (conducted in English and French) that include, but are not limited to:


* Participant interaction, including recruitment and screening, enrollment, informed consent discussions, data collection, and conducting interviews and focus groups
* Moderation of a virtual hub used to foster peer connection and community engagement, including moderating posts and discussion boards, assisting with technical issues, supporting website users, and promoting hub engagement
* Creating social media posts and videos related to smoking cessation information, stories, tips, milestones, and supports
* Assisting with English to French translation of research materials (e.g., protocols, surveys, social media content, knowledge translation products, etc.)
* Supporting stakeholder engagement, including liaising with community agencies, program decision\-makers, and new and existing program implementers
* Assisting with the creation/development, implementation, and evaluation a new clinical program
* Working with people with lived/living experience to plan local community engagement activities across the country. Occasional travel to communities across Canada to host in\-person events with other team members will be required
* Working with open\-source software, such as REDCap
* Supporting the entire lifecycle of data collection, including entry, auditing, quality control, and accuracy assurance
* Conducting literature reviews and summarizing evidence into various formats (scientific papers, reports, briefs, proposals and presentations for diverse audience groups)
* Supporting research activities such as submissions to CAMH’s Research Ethics Board
Assisting with data analysis and quality assurance\-related tasks  
*

* Motion graphics skills (After Effects, animations, etc.)
* Good eye for pacing, visual hierarchy, text placement, and mobile\-first composition (vertical, sound\-off, small screen).

* Experience as a player of gacha, idle, or online role\-playing games (MapleStory, Idleon, AFK Arena, Idle Heroes, Summoners War, Raid: Shadow Legends, etc.)
* Experience with A.I. creative tools for scaling production (image generation, video generation, copy tools) is a strong asset.
* Willingness to learn from performance data. You don't need to be a data analyst, but when a video gets great click\-through rates, you should be curious about why — and ready to make more like it.
* Proactive and independently motivated.
* Positive attitude and genuine interest in mobile games!

**Benefits:**

* We don't require native fluency in English, only a level of proficiency sufficient for creative work and team discussions. We're willing to accommodate for this!
* Collaborative and creative work environment. We operate closely together and treat everyone with respect.

* Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and extended health benefits. This includes massage therapists, physiotherapists, counsellors and more!
* Regular team meals and outings plus an abundance of in\-office snacks, on the house!
* Direct impact on the game's growth — your creatives will be the primary way players find our game.

* Motion graphics skills (After Effects, animations, etc.)
* Good eye for pacing, visual hierarchy, text placement, and mobile\-first composition (vertical, sound\-off, small screen).

* Experience with A.I. creative tools for scaling production (image generation, video generation, copy tools) is a strong asset.
* Willingness to learn from performance data. You don't need to be a data analyst, but when a video gets great click\-through rates, you should be curious about why — and ready to make more like it.
* Proactive and independently motivated.
* Positive attitude and genuine interest in mobile games!

* We don't require native fluency in English, only a level of proficiency sufficient for creative work and team discussions. We're willing to accommodate for this!

* Regular team meals and outings plus an abundance of in\-office snacks, on the house!
* Direct impact on the game's growth — your creatives will be the primary way players find our game.
